Name: Kenneth's Tapper Crops
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Tired of waiting for wild mushrooms and syrups? Grow them![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Tapper Crops adds 7 new tappable crop seeds that grow like crops but produce vanilla mushrooms and syrups.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Common Mushroom - Spring/Summer/Fall, 15 days, regrows in 5 days[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Purple Mushroom - Spring/Summer/Fall, 15 days, regrows in 5 days (rare)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Red Mushroom - Spring/Summer/Fall, 15 days, regrows in 5 days[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Mahogany Tree - All seasons, 28 days, regrows in 14 days (Mystic Syrup)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Maple Tree - All seasons, 20 days, regrows in 7 days (Maple Syrup)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Oak Tree - All seasons, 20 days, regrows in 7 days (Oak Resin)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Pine Tree - All seasons, 20 days, regrows in 7 days (Pine Tar)[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Details:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Works like vanilla tappable crops but as plantable crops[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Balanced - rarer items have higher seed price and longer regrow[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Uses vanilla items for harvest - no custom objects, super compatible[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Super Lightweight - no scripts, no performance impact[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 1.6 compatible[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 13 Languages Supported - English, Filipino/Tagalog (Philippines), Spanish, Italian, German, French, Portuguese, Turkish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hungarian[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Seed Shop (Required) - Seeds are available at Kenneth's Seed Shop[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- SMAPI[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: Does not overwrite vanilla crops. Works alongside my other mods.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation: Drop into Mods folder and run with SMAPI.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Original Art & Inspiration:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]This is a Content Patcher 1.6 conversion of the Json Assets mod by Wandox99. All original sprites and tree art are by Wandox99. Permission was granted by Wandox99 to update and convert the JA version to CP 1.6.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Original JA version by Wandox99:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11609[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Happy farming![/b][/size]
